_comment: 3-DOF robotic arm digital twin - master configuration.
_comment2: Geometry values were measured from 3-DOF-robotic_arm.blend. Do not edit
_comment3: the 'blender' blocks unless the model changes. Tune 'motor', 'limits'
_comment4: and 'safety' freely - those are the calibration knobs.

serial._note: COM4 detected as 'USB-SERIAL CH340'. Uno resets when the port opens; boot_settle_s waits it out.

safety._note_max_travel: Soft limit each joint to +/- this many degrees from home. Start at 10.
safety._note_delta: Largest angle change accepted in one command. Start at 10.
safety._note_speed: 8000 us/step = 125 steps/s = ~1.8 RPM at 4076 steps/rev. Very slow on purpose.
safety._note_min: Never go below 1200 us/step - a 28BYJ-48 stalls and loses position.
safety._note_watchdog: Firmware halts if no serial traffic for this long while moving. 0 disables.
safety._note_hold: false releases the coils when idle (cool, no holding torque). true holds position.

_calibration_howto: steps_per_rev: 4076 is the exact 28BYJ-48 half-step figure (63.68395 gearbox x 64).
Many people use 4096. Yours may differ by a few counts between motors - that is what
this field is for. To calibrate: home the joint, command +10 deg ten times (100 deg),
measure the real angle, then set steps_per_rev = old_value * commanded / measured.
gear_ratio: >1 if the motor drives the joint through extra reduction.
direction: flip to -1 if the physical joint moves opposite to the Blender joint.
